activity_statements.statement: operates a national field force of thousands of merchandising reps who conduct in-store visits to resolve out-of-stocks, fix display compliance, and correct shelf execution issues for CPG brands
provides a real-time retail market intelligence platform with store-level data on pricing, assortment, and product availability across multiple retail banners
delivers structured retail data (pricing, product attribution, distribution) normalized from billions of data points weekly for CPG manufacturers and retailers
serves CPG manufacturers, retailers, and consulting firms seeking competitive pricing intelligence and shelf execution improvement for 35+ years

name_reality_gap: The index label 'Management & Consulting' is misleading. RDSolutions is primarily a field execution and retail data company — it deploys thousands of in-store merchandising reps and operates a data platform. The consulting component is incidental; the core business is physical shelf management and retail intelligence at scale.
extraction_notes: Services and what-we-do pages returned good content on business model. Scale data (thousands of field reps, billions of data points) noted from page without specific numbers. Private company; no 10-K.
